theorems.name: Submission.lower_density_ge_one_of_nearby_mass_bounds
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (Vi : ℕ → Varifold N n U) (V : Varifold N n U) (x : Euclidean N) (ρ₀ Λ : ℝ) (q : ℕ → ℕ) (y : ℕ → Euclidean N), Varifold.RadonConverges Vi V → 0 < ρ₀ → ball x ρ₀ ⊆ U → Tendsto q atTop atTop → Tendsto y atTop (𝓝 x) → (∀ i, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < ρ₀ → ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(Λ * ρ))) * unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal ρ ^ n ≤ (Vi (q i)).weight (closedBall (y i) ρ)) → (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < ρ₀ → ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(Λ * ρ))) * unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal ρ ^ n ≤ V.weight (closedBall x ρ)) ∧ 1 ≤ liminf (densityRatio n V.weight x) (𝓝[>] 0)
